const SPEC_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {

  },

phase('Design')
const specs = await parallel(AREAS.map((a) => () => agent(
  `${SHARED}\n## Your task: resolution DESIGN for the '${a.key}' area (read-only)\nYour files: ${a.files}\nFocus: ${a.focus}\nInspect both sides ('git -C treams-rs show ${OURS}:<path>' / '${THEIRS}:<path>' / 'git diff ${BASE} ${OURS} -- <path>' / 'git diff ${BASE} ${THEIRS} -- <path>', 'git log ${BASE}..${THEIRS} -- <path>' for their intent; rename detection: 'git diff -M --name-status ${BASE} ${THEIRS}').   { label: `design:${a.key}`, phase: 'Design', schema: SPEC_SCHEMA },
